messages.subject: Importing plier expression from APT
parts:
Hi,

I was just wondering is it possible to import a plier summary on Human
exon arrays into aroma affymetrix? I've seen a tutorial on importing
from APT for CN data, http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/import-from-affymetrix-power-tools-apt,
but not for Human Exon array data.

I am assuming it is possible because I see a
AffymetrixAptSummaryFile(). Is there a tutorial available or does
anyone have any idea how to do it?

Thanks,

Fong

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Importing plier expression from APT
parts:
On Fri, Apr 1, 2011 at 3:36 PM, Fong <fongch...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I was just wondering is it possible to import a plier summary on Human
> exon arrays into aroma affymetrix?  I've seen a tutorial on importing
> from APT for CN data, http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/import-from-affymetrix-power-tools-apt,
> but not for Human Exon array data.
>
> I am assuming it is possible because I see a
> AffymetrixAptSummaryFile().  Is there a tutorial available or does
> anyone have any idea how to do it?

Unfortunately not - there is nothing similar for importing exon array
data. The AffymetrixAptSummaryFile() gives you an interface to read
an APT data file, e.g.

df <- AffymetrixAptSummaryFile(pathname);
data <- readDataFrame(df);

Then, in order to import that data.frame ('data') into
*,chipEffects.CEL files is a different story. I don't know what the
content of APT summary files look like for exon data, and how
easy/hard it would be to map it to the CDF structures used in the exon
analysis pipelines of aroma.affymetrix.

Why not just use the aroma.affymetrix pipeline from the start (e.g.
http://aroma-project.org/node/37)? The PLIER summarization method is
not that different from the RMA-style log-additive model.

/Henrik
